evidence.observation: The unchanged working policy scored 971/1000 = 97.10% overall but only 25/54 = 46.3% on folded-required targets, with 0/22 in the deepest 176-180 degree wrapped-open-shoulder band; every measured failure lay in that sector.

This directly confirms the previously circumstantial open-branch saturation mechanism and shows the policy never enters the folded configuration.

The observation's primary branch slots are the open-elbow IK solution (shoulder_open, elbow_open); for folded-required targets that solution names a shoulder angle outside the arm's +/-170 degree hinge range, while the folded-branch slots name the reachable configuration.

Experiment 5 substituted the reachable folded configuration into the open-branch slots under transfer from working and measured folded-required success 0/33 while the parent scored 18/33, and experiments 5-6 show that editing the branch inputs under transfer destroys the branch distinction the policy relies on. That test changed the input under transfer, so its result is confounded by the inherited open-branch mapping and by the campaign-wide transfer drift.

## 59709a6b-6a0b-4fa1-95e7-9b9cba8cdeed / Scientific strategy

**Current synthesis:** The campaign objective is at least 98% official success. The best measured policy remains the experiment-2 baseline checkpoint-100352 (`working`): 4284/4400 = 97.36% pooled over seven distinct research panels, with every measured failure in the folded-required sector, the ~5.4% of uniform targets whose open-elbow IK shoulder angle, once wrapped to ±180°, exceeds the arm's ±170° hinge range. The sector is not uniform: pooled folded-sector success is 124/240 = 51.7%, about 94-100% for |wrapped| 170-176° but 0-2% for 176-180°. A direct joint-trajectory diagnostic on the retained `working` policy (600 episodes of panel seed 26000, reproducing the recorded panel outcome) resolves the previously circumstantial mechanism: on all 31 folded-required episodes the shoulder was driven to its ±170° joint limit (median |shoulder at minimum distance - limit| = 2.2°), the elbow stayed on the positive open-branch sign, and the shoulder never approached the folded-branch solution (median separation 103-111°); folded successes occurred only where the clamped open geometry happened to reach the 1 cm tolerance (min distance 0.12-0.86 cm). The policy therefore selects the out-of-range open-branch solution and saturates the shoulder; it never enters the folded configuration. Seven experiments now form one negative family: experiment 3 (radius coverage) and experiment 6 (open-shoulder wrap projection) were flat or harmful; experiment 4 (terminal-precision reward), experiment 5 (feasible-folded substitution) and experiment 7 (50/50 folded target mixture) degraded behavior. Experiment 7 is the strongest evidence against a training-exposure explanation: with the deep 176-180° band at roughly 20% of training targets the measured folded rate stayed at 46-48%, and the run's own training proxy equalled the parent's folded ceiling. Experiments 5 and 6 show that editing the branch inputs under transfer destroys the branch distinction the policy relies on. Training proxies (success_rate, ep_rew_mean) disagreed with measured behavior in every run.

**Lessons and limits:** Reusable: measured task outcome, not training success_rate or ep_rew_mean, must select models; behavior within a late plateau is homogeneous, so checkpoint selection inside a plateau is low-value. The folded/open kinematic partition is the cleanest structural predictor of failure and, inside it, the wrapped open-branch shoulder value. New: the folded-required residual is now a directly observed branch-selection failure - the policy saturates the shoulder against its limit on the open-branch solution and never enters the folded basin - rather than a precision, radius or exposure gap; the 1 cm tolerance is met only where the clamped open geometry allows it. Transfer from `working` has degraded measured behavior in every changed run (experiments 3-7), so transfer is a poor vehicle for testing a changed input or reward and the intervention-versus-drift confound is unresolved. Limits: one training seed and one recipe lineage; seven checkpoints measured; the trajectory diagnostic used the single retained artifact on one 600-episode panel and deterministic replay, and the branch partition and folded-solution separation are kinematic computations from recorded target geometry and joint limits; the deep-band and sector conclusions rest on the pooled seven-panel evidence, and the task-reference panel is reused and selection-contaminated.

**Open questions:** Whether the current method can learn the folded branch when its primary branch input is always joint-limit-feasible is not known: experiment 5 tested that input change only under transfer, where the inherited open-branch mapping confounds the result. Whether the residual is instead an intrinsic optimization or representation ceiling of the 64x64 policy and distance-based reward is likewise not decided by any fresh-initialization test. Whether the marginal folded failures are static offsets or small limit cycles is not captured by the recorded diagnostics, and whether the 98.0% task-reference reading reflects a genuine level or one-panel variance remains open. These are recorded uncertainties, not priorities and not a queue of required actions.

working_lineage.reason: Experiment 8's fresh feasible-primary-input hypothesis is contradicted and its recipe is not competitive. On the fresh disjoint 2000-episode panel seed 27000 the retained working policy (experiment-2 checkpoint-100352) scored 1948/2000 = 97.40% (open-feasible 1888/1888 = 100%, folded-required 60/112 = 53.6%) while experiment-8 checkpoint-115712 scored 1898/2000 = 94.90% (folded 10/112 = 8.9%) and checkpoint-120832 scored 1892/2000 = 94.60% (folded 12/112 = 10.7%); working won both paired comparisons (54 vs 4 and 62 vs 6 discordant wins). The intervention is therefore actively harmful in the folded sector it targeted, including the shallow 170-174 degree band (100% -> 11-13%), and no experiment-8 checkpoint approaches the working lineage. Working remains the best measured policy at 6232/6400 = 97.375% pooled over eight distinct research panels, still below the 98% objective with all residual behavior in the folded-required sector, so terminal assessment is not justified. Development continues from working into a further ordinary experiment; the campaign proceeds rather than ending.
